svg.title: A tool definition is text in the prompt
svg.desc: Left: the three fields of a tool definition, name, description and parameters. Right: a bar chart of prompt size with a Qwen2.5 chat template: 42 tokens with no tool, 212 with one, 283 with two, 498 with five and 838 with ten.
